sources.title: BerrYum - six named blackberry products and labeled fruit photos
sources.enumerated_scope: Six current product cards checked on their individual product pages. The comparison chart contains these six base labels and the separate Loch Ness comparator.
sources.limitations: This is a bounded current page, not a lifetime release portfolio. BerrYum remains a brand, not an inferred company or breeder. Sibling product cards repeat names; production calendar repeats Furia and Kalika by growing system and does not add cultivars. Loch Ness is not a BerrYum product. No raspberry names are supplied by this page. Marketed/base label pairs and image associations remain unreviewed. Some thumbnail links point to other varieties, so photos use individual product-page labels. Publisher photos require written consent; none is recorded.
